title: A fixed regular-unit normalization for completed Koszul degree zero
statement: Let T be a scheme, A a commutative ring, d an adic coefficient datum, r a natural number, and a:Fin r to A. Use the actual constant module functor and completed scalar extension of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], and put E equal to their composite. There exists one isomorphism c0 from the regular completed module to E of the regular ULift A-module such that, for every n, c0 followed by E of the inverse exteriorPower.zeroEquiv and the extension identification in exterior degree zero is exactly completedAdicKoszulUnitZero(T,d,r,a,n). No tensor of complexes, tower comparison, quotient, or augmentation is asserted.

source.place: section-tensor-product (03EK), regular-module scalar tensor and sheafification; proetale.tex, proof of lemma-naive-completion (099M), realization of the constant Koszul complex.

proof.text: The normalized constant regular-module map sends 1 to its sheafification. Construct its inverse by the module-sheafification adjunction, sending this generator to 1. Both composites are identity: maps from the regular module are determined by 1, and the adjunction reduces the other equation to that same generator.

At each object of the site, the heterobasic tensor isomorphism sends s tensor r to s*phi(r). Its restriction compatibility is naturality of phi. Sheafify this presheaf isomorphism and compose with the adjunction counit at the target regular module. The hom-equivalence of the adjunction proves the section formula, and applying the inverse shows that 1 is sent to the sheafification of 1 tensor 1.

Compose the inverse scalar regular-unit isomorphism, the recorded object equality for completed scalar extension, and scalar extension of the constant regular-module isomorphism. This explicitly constructs c0. The scalar-extension morphism formula sends normalized tensors to normalized tensors of the image. Thus, at every n, c0 followed by the realized exterior degree-zero identification has the defining value of the actual completed Koszul unit on 1. The unit-module/sections equivalence gives equality. These constructions also apply to rank zero, the zero ring, and an empty scheme.

lean.statement:
theorem completedKoszulRegularUnitNormalization
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) :
    let E := koszulConstantFunctor T A ⋙ completedAdicScalarExtension T d
    ∃ c₀ : SheafOfModules.unit (completedAdicRing T d) ≅
        E.obj (ModuleCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} A) (ULift.{t + 1} A)),
      ∀ n : ℕ, completedAdicKoszulUnitZero T d r a n = c₀.hom ≫ E.map
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv (ULift.{t + 1} A)
          (Fin r →₀ ULift.{t + 1} A)).symm.toLinearMap ≫
          ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex (ULift.{t + 1} A) r
            (fun i ↦ ULift.up (a i ^ (n + 1)))).extendXIso
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := 0) rfl).inv)
